classification.authority: single-process default-off mainline real-checkpoint startup, short loopback evaluation-adapter health, route-accounting, thermal, memory, and bounded shutdown observation

claim_boundary: This record closes the real-model health observation required after the 2026-08-21 delivery-mainline branch absorption. It proves that the exact BUILD_TESTING=OFF mainline binary started the pinned real checkpoint, served one warmup plus eight measured short requests and one separately retained raw-SSE request, remained within the declared thermal envelope, and exited without an observed server-owned nvmap residue. The absorbed code delta changed only the installed-package consumer version assertion, so this run establishes no performance improvement. The eight-request loopback workload is not the final product API, a 32-request reference baseline, a 40K/60K/approximately-130K witness, a Prefill architecture selector, or a release/production qualification.

source.absorbed_delta: The selected change updates the installed package-consumer fixture from version 0.4 to the repository's existing version 0.5 contract.

identity_limitations: This run record retains shard sizes but not the three shard SHA-256 values.
No root-level quantization_config.json existed; quantization identity is inherited from the pinned config and model-index contracts rather than a separately hashed file.

hardware.machine: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit
hardware.identity_limitation: The raw acceptance summary freezes the L4T, kernel, nvpmodel, and jetson_clocks observations, but it did not embed the CUDA SDK, runtime, compiler, or driver versions. Those four values are a post-run environment inventory and not same-file run attestation.

clean_host_preflight.jetson_idle_authority: tegrastats plus CPU/process and complete GPU-device FD inspection; Jetson nvidia-smi was not used

startup.scope: process spawn through exec, real-model loading, resource preparation, server readiness, and health polling at at-most 100 ms intervals

workload.finish_reason: length for all eight measured requests
workload.completion_limit_note: All measured requests reached the declared 16-token performance-workload cap. This proves workload completion, not answer completeness.

evalscope_result.throughput_source: workload_throughput.json and independent token-count/window recomputation; benchmark_summary.json Input Throughput=0.0 is a known invalid field and is not cited
evalscope_result.percentile_limitation: With eight request samples, request-level p95 and p99 both collapse to the maximum and are not stable tail-latency estimates. ITL percentiles use 120 token intervals and therefore have a different grain.

protocol_and_route.witness_breakdown: one warmup plus eight measured requests
limitations: The default legacy route is exact but is not fallback-free.
DeploymentPlan is not implemented, cache hits are not instrumented, and first-byte timing is not instrumented.

EvalScope 1.9.1 does not retain the final empty-choices usage event in its database; the separately retained raw-SSE request proves protocol shape but does not substitute for per-request usage retention.

thermal_and_hardware_runtime.frequency_observation: All 4,848 sampled CPU-core frequency values were 2,201 MHz. The frozen clock configuration reports GPU 1,300.5 MHz and EMC 3,200 MHz, but the runtime tegrastats lines did not report GPU/EMC frequency or EMC utilization, so per-sample GPU/EMC locking is not claimed.

memory.scope_note: The first system-memory sample was taken 0.848 seconds after spawn, not before spawn. /proc VmRSS, smaps RSS/PSS/private, system MemAvailable, tegrastats RAM, and nvmap are overlapping views and must not be summed.

shutdown_and_recovery.classification: No server-owned nvmap residue was observed after exit.
shutdown_and_recovery.limit: This bounded before/after observation is not a general no-memory-leak proof. The IOVMM and system-memory differences may reflect allocator caches or background variation and are not added to process memory.

retained_artifacts.harness_identity_limitation: The harness mtime preceded the run and its logic matches the retained artifacts, but the raw summary did not embed the harness SHA-256 or a top-level harness exit-code receipt.

discarded_diagnostic.reason: The complete 32-request diagnostic crossed the predeclared 70C thermal boundary. Its otherwise complete protocol and timing values are not retained as a valid performance baseline.

known_limits: One fresh process and one measurement round were observed; no independent-process repetition was run.
The eight-request sample is too small for stable request-tail estimates and is not comparable to the retained 32-request stock-vLLM reference.
The hardware software-stack revision differs from the retained R39.2.0 reference environment.
The loopback evaluation adapter is not the final product API or an authenticated DeploymentPlan route.
No 40K, 60K, or approximately-130K workload was run, and paused Prefill work was not resumed.
No speedup is attributed to the selected branch absorption because it did not change runtime source.
